1.The audited condensed interim Standalone financial statements as of June 30, 2024, have been taken on record by the Board at its meeting held on July 18, 2024, as recommended by the Audit Committee at its meeting held on July 17, 2024. The statutory auditors have expressed an unmodified audit opinion. The information presented above is extracted from the audited condensed interim Standalone financial statements.   2.The above Standalone financial results have been prepared from the condensed interim Standalone financial statements, which are prepared in accordance with Ind AS, the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 as applicable issued by SEBI guidelines. All amounts included in the Standalone financial results (including notes) are reported in INR million except share and per share data, unless otherwise stated.   3.Persistent India Foundation was incorporated under Section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013 w.e.f. May 1, 2024, as a WOS of the Company.   4.Software Company International, LLC (SDS) has been dissolved w.e.f June 27, 2024.   5.Persistent Systems Inc, USA (WOS) entered into a SPA on July 2, 2024 (EDT)/ July 3, 2024 (IST) for the acquisition of Starfish Associates, LLC, USA. Upon completion of the customary closing conditions, Starfish will become a SDS of the Company and a WOS of PSI.   6.Based on the Board approval at its meeting held on January 20, 2024, the 2nd  tranche of 600,000 Equity Shares of INR 5 each was allotted to the ESOP Trust on July 10, 2024, at an allotment price of INR 643.50 per Equity Share, aggregating to the total consideration of INR 386.10M.   7.Ms. Anjali Joshi was appointed as an Additional Director (Independent Member) of the Company by the Board of Directors w.e.f. June 12, 2024. The members at the 34th AGM held on July 16, 2024, confirmed her appointment as the Independent Director of the Company to hold office for the term of 5 consecutive years i.e., from June 12, 2024, to June 11, 2029.   8.The re-appointment of Mr. Sunil Sapre as the Executive Director of the Company was approved and recommended by the Board of Directors to the Members for their approval and the members at the 34th AGM held on July 16, 2024, confirmed his re-appointment as the Executive Director of the Company to hold office for the period of 3 months i.e., from October 1, 2024, to December 31, 2024.   9.The re-appointment of Mr. Praveen Kadle as the Independent Director of the Company, was approved and recommended by the Board of Directors to the Members for their approval, and the members at the 34th AGM held on July 16, 2024, approved his re-appointment as the Independent Director of the Company, not liable to retire by rotation, to hold office for the second term of 5 consecutive years i.e., from April 23, 2025, to April 22, 2030.   10.Ms. Roshini Bakshi, Independent Director of the Company retired effective from the conclusion of the 34th AGM upon completion of her second term as the Independent Director of the Company.   11.Mr. Sunil Sapre relinquished his position as the CFO of the Company w.e.f. May 15, 2024, and Mr. Vinit Teredesai has been appointed as the CFO of the Company effective from May 15, 2024. Further, Mr. Sapre continued as the Executive Director of the Company.   12.During the quarter ended June 30, 2024, the Group has reversed the earnout payable towards acquisition of business to the erstwhile shareholders of Data Glove Incorporated and Software Corporation International and SCI Fusion 360, LLC amounting to INR 636.18 million based on settlement agreement and expected payout assessed by management.   13. In accordance with para 4 of notified Ind AS-108 ���Operating Segments���, the Company has disclosed segment information only on the basis of Standalone financial results.

1.The audited condensed interim standalone financial statements as of March 31, 2024, have been taken on record by the Board at its meeting held on April 21, 2024 as recommended by the Audit Committee at its meeting held on April 20, 2024. The statutory auditors have expressed an unmodified audit opinion. The information presented above is extracted from the audited condensed interim standalone financial statements.   2.The above results have been prepared from the condensed interim standalone financial statements, which are prepared in accordance with Ind AS, the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 as applicable and guidelines issued by the SEBI. The Ind AS are prescribed under Sec 133 of the Companies Act read with relevant Rule. All amounts included in the standalone financial results (including notes) are reported in in INR Millions except share and per share data, unless otherwise stated.   3.The Board at its meeting held on Jan 20, 2024, approved the issuance of 1,000,000 equity shares of INR 10 each to the ESOP Trust in multiple tranches during the calendar year 2024 and authorized the SRC Committee to allot the said Equity Shares to the ESOP Trust.    Accordingly, the first tranche of 100,000 equity shares of INR 10 each was allotted to the ESOP Trust on Feb 1, 2024, at a consideration of INR 2,133 per equity share aggregating to the total consideration of INR 213.3 million. Consequent to this, the number of shares of paid-up share capital of the Company was increased from 76,925,000 equity shares to 77,025,000 equity shares of INR 10 each and the listing process of aforesaid shares was completed w.e.f Mar 1, 2024.   4.Persistent Systems S.R.L, Italy has been dissolved w.e.f Feb 26, 2024.   5.The Board at its meeting held on Jan 20, 2024, approved the Scheme of Merger of Capiot Software Private Limited into Persistent Systems Limited, and accordingly, an application of Merger has been filed with the NCLT on Mar 22, 2024.   6.The Members of the Company approved the Split of 1 fully paid up equity share of INR 10 each into 2 fully paid up equity shares of INR 5 each through a postal ballot with a requisite majority and the voting results were declared on March 11, 2024.   Record Date for Split was Apr 1, 2024.   Consequent to this, the authorized share capital comprises 400,000,000 equity shares having a FV of INR 5 each aggregating to INR 2,000,000,000, and the paid-up capital comprises 154,050,000 equity shares having a FV of INR 5 each aggregating to INR 770,250,000.   7.The Board at its meeting held on Jan 20, 2024, approved the payment of an Interim Dividend of INR 32 per Equity Share of INR 10 each for FY 2023-24. Accordingly, an amount of INR 2,461,573,386.75 was paid as an Interim Dividend out of the total dividend amount of INR 2,461,600,000.00. The remaining amount of INR 26,613.25 is unclaimed and the Company will make due efforts to pay the same to the respective Shareholders.    8.The SPA for the transfer of the 100% shareholding of Persistent Systems UK Limited to Persistent Systems Limited was executed on Mar 19, 2024.   9.The BTA has been executed for the transfer of the business of the UK Branch of the Company to Persistent Systems UK Limited effective from Apr 1, 2024.   10.The Company has applied for incorporation of a Company (Not for Profit) under Section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013 on April 9, 2024, with the MCA   11.The Board at its meeting on Apr 21, 2024, recommended a Final Dividend of INR 10 per Equity Share of INR 5 each for FY 2023-24. This Final Dividend is subject to the approval of the Members at the ensuing 34th AGM of the Company.   12.In accordance with para 4 of notified Ind AS-108 ���Operating Segments���, the Company has disclosed segment information only on the basis of consolidated financial results.   13.The investors are requested to visit the following website of the Company and stock exchanges for further details.
